title: Impact of mixing states on aerosol radiative effects and feedback during winter haze episodes over the North China Plain
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2026, 6,310-323
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00126A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jing Wang, Zhiwei Han, Yunfei Wu, Jiawei Li, Yuanyuan Zheng
There are large differences in the aerosol direct radiative effect (DRE) and radiative feedback-induced changes in PM2.5 across various aerosol mixing states (external, Maxwell-Garnett, core–shell, homogeneous) during haze episodes in NCP of China.
